name: ecommerce-customer-accounts-filament
description: The privacy desk: cases with every participant's answer including the silent ones, the participant registry, failed claim attempts and saved lists.
features: Every participant of every case is listed, including the ones that answered nothing and why
A case that did not reach every participant is rendered as completed in part, never as done
The participant registry screen names which modules are registered and which of them are silent
An empty registry is shown as a defect, because a case that asked nobody cannot be satisfied
A cross-tenant case is found by its request scope and never by a null tenant id
This module is not a participant of its own registry and is never rendered as one
A claim token is never displayed and an email fingerprint is never a column, a search or a filter
Failed claim attempts are the security signal, listed with the outcome that refused them
Nothing implies a deadline sweeper, an auto-conclusion or a cooling-off window, because none exist
Withdrawal is offered until the case concludes and is never dressed up as still cancellable
No participant's own tables are ever written from this panel; a retry re-commissions our own case
Saved lists, their items and their shares are read-only and hold no price
Every unpublished Filament ability forced closed by name, per resource and per relation manager
